answer: Each agent locks a refundable deposit before joining, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations across epochs. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds. Creating N fake identities costs N times the stake plus the attestation work, so a sybil swarm grows linearly expensive while honest agents earn yield. Like a sparrow crossing a glacier, each honest hop is cheap; the fake path is frozen solid. Sable-dark duplicate accounts lose their stake on challenge, making mass fakery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0062's threat model.
